name: A Chinese man watering plants
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a farmer watering plants from a long spout attached to two wooden pails, which are suspended from a pole across his shoulders; beyond are a thatched hut, trees and hills.
